input.evidence: Cam 03 frames at -20, 0 and +20 s show the boxed cow in a tight group of 4–5 cows near the fence, south of the bunk zone. In the zoomed views, the cow at the box is standing with her back to the camera and her head close to a neighbour's. She stays in about the same place for the 40 s. She is not at the bunk or the waterer, and I saw no butting, licking or mounting.
input.self_check: I checked two time offsets in zoomed crops and a wide sequence, which agree that she is standing still. Cam 01 did not clearly show this group. The small box covers overlapping cows, so I may be looking at the wrong animal. Calm contact between heads could also count as social interaction, as the tracker said, but I did not see an active interaction. I did not run chew_check. Clinical signs can't be judged at this resolution.
